sources.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
sources.scope: Demonstrates zero-shot visual transfer on evaluated datasets. Not universal understanding.

sources.title: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
sources.scope: Learned particle simulations generalize within evaluated settings. No universal causal engine is established.

sources.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
sources.scope: Strong benchmark protein-structure prediction; accuracy and applicability have limitations.

sources.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
sources.scope: Transfers web-derived representations to evaluated robot tasks. Does not establish general robot reliability.

sources.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
sources.scope: Action diffusion is demonstrated for visuomotor control on selected manipulation tasks.

sources.title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery
sources.scope: Predicts candidate crystal stability. Computation is not synthesis, performance validation, or manufacturability.

sources.title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
sources.scope: Reports an automated inorganic-powder synthesis workflow. Broad autonomous scientific discovery remains a separate claim.

sources.title: Critical interphase overpotential as a lithium dendrite-suppression criterion
sources.scope: Studies dendrite suppression criteria in solid-state cells; not proof of an industrial battery specification.

sources.title: Reprogramming to recover youthful epigenetic information and restore vision
sources.scope: Reports retinal-cell reprogramming and functional effects in mice. Does not establish systemic human rejuvenation.

sources.title: DunedinPACE, a DNA methylation biomarker of the pace of aging
sources.scope: Reports a methylation-based pace-of-aging measure trained on longitudinal physiological change; not a validated treatment surrogate.

sources.title: Effect of long-term caloric restriction on DNA methylation measures of biological aging
sources.scope: A randomized trial evaluates methylation aging measures. Biomarker movement does not establish longer healthy lifespan.
